dialogues.speaker: Hawad
dialogues.text: Ajilenakh Nuts have been the most in demand lately.

dialogues.speaker: Hawad
dialogues.text: Ajilenakh Nuts are a common crop that the people of the desert used to plant. They make pretty good desserts and candy because of their high sugar content.

dialogues.speaker: Hawad
dialogues.text: Sweets make people happy, so I guess that's where its popularity comes from.

dialogues.speaker: Hawad
dialogues.text: I heard researchers from the Akademiya are even trying to find out which type of light produces sweeter Ajilenakh Nuts. I really look forward to their results.
